Name: Give Adri 5 items
Title: Bring weapon components to Adri
Description:
Bring weapon components to Adri

Adri Afeli dabbles with weapons technology and has found a way to increase the output of some simple weapons. He has uploaded a list of five items he's looking for. As a reward for your hard work, he will give you a better weapon of your choice.

The list he gave you is:

- Power Supply (Cargo Droid)
- Compression Chamber (Waste Collector)
- Bone Plates (Cliff Malle)
- Stalker Limbs (Tropical Stalker)
- Rollerrat Intestines (Rollerrat)
- A basic weapon

If you don't have a weapon, you can buy one from Antonio Stacklund.

Click the "Map" button on the menu in the lower right corner, then select the new "Map" button that shows up to open the local map for easier navigation. You may also toggle this map by pressing CTRL+6 key on the keyboard.
